change_summary: Replaced two-pass scalar loop structure with single-pass 2D register tile: load all 64 channels into [XBLOCK, BLOCK_R] register tile in one tl.load, compute RMS via tl.sum+tl.rsqrt, normalize in-register, and store — eliminating all Pass 2 DRAM reloads (~50% fewer loads). Updated autotune configs to smaller XBLOCK values (64, 128, 256) to manage increased register pressure from holding XBLOCK*64 values in registers.
